message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Method | Contact Info | Notes |
|--------|--------------|-------|
| **Phone** | 311 (non‑emergency) – 404‑656‑3111 | Works 24/7; you’ll be routed to the appropriate department. |
| **Online** | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | Use the “Report a Problem” form and select “Noise Complaint.” |
| **In‑person** | City Hall, 55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303 | You can visit the City Clerk’s office or the Police Department’s non‑emergency desk. |

When filing, provide:
* Your name and contact information (optional but helpful).
* Exact address or intersection of the noisy property.
* Time(s) of the disturbance and a brief description (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs).
* Any relevant photos or audio clips (if available).

The City of Atlanta’s Police Department typically handles noise complaints. They will investigate and may issue warnings or citations if the noise violates city ordinances. If you’re dealing with a recurring issue, you can follow up by calling 311 or checking the status of your online ticket.
